title: Mobility Functional Status Ascertainment in Electronic Health Records using Large Language Models
details: X Liu, M Garg, H Jia, JS Sauver, SR Pagali, S Sohn - 2025
abstract: With global aging, assessing functional status is vital for precision medicine. Electronic Health Records (EHRs), particularly unstructured data, hold abundant information on patient mobility. This study explores using Large Language Models …
